verdict.rationale: Devin exposes an API, MCP server, and Devin Handoff (open-source plugin usable across other coding agents) which allow integration with the broader ecosystem, but there is no evidence of a marketplace, app-store, or documented mechanism for plugging in third-party partner-built agent apps into Devin's own workflows. missing for 10: evidence of a partner/app marketplace, documented third-party agent-app integrations, or case studies of external vendor agents being incorporated into Devin workflows.
